title: Add exact-tenant Frequency reply aliases with versioned proof and inbound quarantine
detail: Source prerequisite only, not full tenant-inbound completion. Immediate Space compose may issue a compact slug-derived r2 member alias only behind an off-by-default operator flag with explicit existing receiving domain and authenticated webhook configuration. Durable service-only mapping and HMAC bind alias/version/Space/conversation/ref/domain; inbound checks live tenant mapping and revocation before using the existing conversation append store. Malformed, ambiguous, wrong-domain, forged, unknown, revoked or cross-tenant aliases persist fingerprint-only quarantine and never enter contact-match fallback. Lookup, quarantine or append faults request provider redelivery. Legacy reply tokens and house routing stay intact; disabled issuance and paid downgrade do not revoke old aliases. No custom receiving provisioning, DNS, apex MX change or activation claim. Full tenant-inbound remains dependent on durable provider events and identity model, both open. Batch/campaign alias coverage, owner revocation controls, retention and integrated pilot still pending. No live SQL/provider/DNS/mail executed.

Targeted ESLint/diff, schema contract (zero phantoms), admin-client ratchet, RLS posture, table grants, FK indexes and one-list PASS. Actual eight-assertion pgTAP fixture passes in strengthened isolated PGlite reduced dependency schema; this is not full historical-schema or independent-connection race proof.
